answer: The most convincing sybil defense is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster: each agent's identity score is built from vouches weighted by social distance, so agents in the same tightly-linked ring vouching for each other earn zero, because their attestations fall inside one cluster. A fake-identity attacker must wander far across the real graph, slowly accumulating trust like marble worn smooth by genuine traffic, and can never turn the haven
